translationRepairs: On gengzi, Jingnan military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Prince of Nanping Gao Jixing was made acting Grand Marshal and concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Zelu military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, co-equal Chief Councilor Kong was also made concurrent Palace Attendant.

On gengzi, Jingnan military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Prince of Nanping Gao Jixing was made acting Grand Marshal and concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Zelu military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, co-equal Chief Councilor Kong Qing was also made concurrent Palace Attendant.
The Zelu commissioner 孔 is Kong Qing: his biography records the same Zelu appointment followed by Heyang. Expanding the English reference disambiguates the official.

On gengzi Gao Jixing of Jingnan—acting Grand Preceptor, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Prince of Nanping—became acting Grand Marshal with the directorate; Zelu commissioner Kong, acting Grand Marshal and co-equal councilor, also gained concurrent Palace Attendant.

On gengzi Gao Jixing of Jingnan—acting Grand Preceptor, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Prince of Nanping—became acting Grand Marshal with the directorate; Zelu commissioner Kong Qing, acting Grand Marshal and co-equal councilor, also gained concurrent Palace Attendant.
Kong Qing's biography and continuous office sequence identify the surname-only Zelu commissioner.
An Chonghui, Privy Council commissioner, was made acting Grand Preceptor and Left Leading Infantry General while keeping the Privy Council post.
An Chonghui, Privy Council commissioner, was made acting Minister of Works and Left Leading Infantry General while keeping the Privy Council post.
Chinese 檢校司空 is the acting Sikong (Minister of Works); 太師 would be Grand Preceptor. The proposed replacement matches the title.
Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui was made acting Grand Preceptor, held as Left Leading Infantry General, and continued as before as Privy Council commissioner.
Privy Council commissioner An Chonghui was made acting Minister of Works, held as Left Leading Infantry General, and continued as before as Privy Council commissioner.
Literal likewise misreads 檢校司空 as Grand Preceptor; Minister of Works is the correct office.
On yimao Bohai's King Da Yinse sent tribute envoys.
On yimao Bohai's King Da Yinzhuan sent tribute envoys.
大諲譔 romanizes as Da Yinzhuan; Da Yinse invents a different given name.
That month Zhang Xian, Beiping deputy commissioner, was executed for losing his post.
That month Zhang Xian, Northern Capital deputy commissioner, was executed for losing his post.
In this Later Tang annal 北京 is the Northern Capital (Taiyuan), not Beiping; the replacement restores the place title.
On wuchen, Golden-Glitter Grand Master of Splendid Culture and acting Grand Preceptor Zhao Zaili was made Huazhou military commissioner and acting Grand Guardian.
On wuchen, Golden-Glitter Grand Master of Splendid Culture and acting Minister of Works Zhao Zaili was made Huazhou military commissioner and acting Grand Guardian.
Zhao Zaili's held title is 檢校司空 (acting Minister of Works), not Grand Preceptor.

On renwu, former Yunzhou prefect Zhang Wen was made Zhenwu acting military commissioner; left-and-right wing assault-array commanders Kang Yicheng and Suo Zitong were made Fenzhou and Xinzhou prefects.

On renwu, former Weizhou prefect Zhang Wen was made Zhenwu acting military commissioner; left-and-right wing assault-array commander Kang Yicheng was made Fenzhou prefect; left-and-right wing cavalry commander Suo Zitong was made Xinzhou prefect.
Chinese has 蔚州 (Weizhou), not Yunzhou, and assigns Kang and Suo distinct prior offices and separate prefectures; the proposed literal restores that structure.
Li Congke, Hedong acting commissioner, became Hedong commissioner; the court congratulated him.
Li Congke, Hezhong acting commissioner, became Hezhong commissioner; the court congratulated him.
河中 is Hezhong; Hedong would be 河東. The replacement corrects the circuit name.
Lu Zhi, Hanlin edict-drafter and War minister, became acting grand preceptor and Tong commissioner.
Lu Zhi, Hanlin edict-drafter and War minister, became acting Minister of Works and Tong commissioner.
Lu Zhi was made 檢校司空, acting Minister of Works, not grand preceptor.
Kong Xun, acting Bian prefect, reported that the mutinous commanders led by Zhao Xu—three thousand men and below—had been wiped out to the clan.
Kong Xun, acting Bian prefect, reported that the mutinous commanders led by Zhao Qian—three thousand men and below—had been wiped out to the clan.
The rebel commander is 趙虔 (Zhao Qian); Zhao Xu does not match the graph 虔.

On dingmao Wang Yan of false Shu—acting Works minister, gate councilor, co-equal councilor, and Duke of Jin—became acting Works minister and Ling prefect; Shi Tan of Guo became Yao training commissioner.

On dingmao Wang Xie of false Shu—acting Works minister, gate councilor, co-equal councilor, and Duke of Jin—became acting Works minister and Ling prefect; Shi Tan of Guo became Yao training commissioner.
王諧 is Wang Xie; Wang Yan confuses him with Former Shu’s 王衍.
Yang Bin, Minister of Personnel of the false Shu, was made Supervising Secretary, appointed Academician of the Hall for Collecting Worthies, and placed in acting charge of the institute.
Yang Bin, Minister of Personnel of the false Shu, was made Drafting Attendant, appointed Academician of the Hall for Collecting Worthies, and placed in acting charge of the institute.
Yang Bin receives 給事中, the same office rendered Drafting Attendant for Yang Ningshi in the preceding unit; Supervising Secretary breaks that consistency.
One ran the Three Bureaus and handed affairs to Yuan Sui;
One ran the Three Bureaus and handed affairs to original retainers;
元隨 is the common noun for original retainers, not a personal name Yuan Sui.
One held the Three Bureaus and entrusted affairs to Yuan Sui;
One held the Three Bureaus and entrusted affairs to original retainers;
Literal likewise invents Yuan Sui from 元隨; original retainers is the correct reading.
On jimao, Revenue Bureau director and edict drafter Yang Ningshi was made Drafting Attendant, charged as History Office reviser and acting director;
On jimao, Bureau of Review director and edict drafter Yang Ningshi was made Drafting Attendant, charged as History Office reviser and acting director;
比部郎中 is director of the Bureau of Review, not the Revenue Bureau.

Doulu Sheng, Tongzhou Changchun Palace aide, Court Gentleman for Prolonging Grace, acting Director of the Secretariat, Director in the Ministry of Rites, and recipient of the purple-gold fish bag, and Wei Tao, Preparation Gentleman, acting Outer-Section Director of the Ministry of Revenue Bureau of State Farms, Academician of the Chongwen Hall, and recipient of the scarlet fish bag, had each relied on power and influence to enter official ranks suddenly. They had no talents or achievements worth commending, yet had long stolen favor and honor.

Dou Lu Sheng, Tongzhou Changchun Palace aide, Court Gentleman for Prolonging Grace, acting Director of the Secretariat, Director in the Ministry of Rites, and recipient of the purple-gold fish bag, and Wei Tao, Preparation Gentleman, acting Outer-Section Director of the Ministry of Revenue Bureau of State Farms, Academician of the Chongwen Hall, and recipient of the scarlet fish bag, had each relied on power and influence to enter official ranks suddenly. They had no talents or achievements worth commending, yet had long stolen favor and honor.
豆盧 is the compound surname Dou Lu; fused Doulu mismatches the chapter’s Dou Lu Ge spelling.
